turns.q: By the way, what does carpet area vs super area mean?
turns.answer:
Carpet area is the actual usable floor space inside your apartment where you can lay a carpet—measured from inner wall to inner wall—excluding exterior walls and balconies. 

Super built-up area is the total saleable area charged by developers, which adds a **25% to 35% loading factor** on top of the carpet area to account for your share of common spaces like lift lobbies, staircases, corridors, and clubhouses. 

When evaluating property prices, always calculate your cost per square foot based on the net usable carpet area rather than the gross super built-up area to understand the true value of the space you are buying.
